第1章打劫到修仙者
碧空如洗，万里无云。
赵国，东域边缘荒凉之地，一处商道。
……
“此山是我开，此树是我栽……姑娘，打个劫。”
一个十五六岁的少年，穿着一件粗布衣服，扛着一把破刀，稚嫩的脸上故作凶狠的道。
在他身后，站着十多个汉子。
这些汉子身上的衣服破破烂烂，如同乞丐一般。
除了少数几人，拿着铁兵器以外，大多数人都拿着木棍，显得很窘迫，不过穷凶极恶的样子，对于普通人来说，还是很有威慑力。
他们是这一带的山贼，靠打劫商道的过路人为生。
而站在最前面的少年，名叫林浩。
是这群山贼中唯一认识字的人，刚成为这群山贼的头目没几个月。
前方被拦住的女人，约莫二十多岁，长相极美。
她穿着名贵的衣服，与这群落魄的山贼，形成鲜明对比。
被这么多人，挡住去路。
她面色很冷，似乎并不害怕，目光落在领头的林浩身上道：“没想到在这偏僻之地，还能遇到个有修炼资质的人，既然遇上便是缘分，跟我走吧。”
这声音，如腊月寒风一般，蕴含着某种神秘力量。
听在一众山贼的耳朵中，莫名的心惊肉跳。
话音刚落，便见那女子手对着林浩虚空一抓。
顿时一股力量缠住了他，在他惊恐的表情中身体不受控制的往前飞去。

女子白皙的手，又是一挥，一股青光笼罩住了林浩，使他无法动弹。
“大当……家！”
一群山贼毛骨悚然，握着兵器的手满是冷汗，却不敢冲上去。
显然，这女子的能力，超出了他们的理解范围。
“小的们……救我……”
林浩神色恐惧哭丧着脸道：“姑娘……饶命，我……我只劫财，从未伤过他人性命，放过我吧！”
他本是地球上一名年纪不大的普通少年，因为去某座名山旅游，意外掉落山崖，莫名其妙来到了这个世界，成为了万中无一的穿越者。
不是魂穿，而是真身穿越的那种。
等他醒来，就发现自己在山贼窝中，靠着现代人的知识，好不容易忽悠住这群山贼，当上头目。
没想到从事山贼事业没多久，就打劫遇到铁板。
“闭嘴。”
女子冷冷的看了他一眼，那眼神如同索命的阎王一样可怕。
林浩吓得不敢吱声，浑身发抖，内心紧张的站在女子散发出来的青光中。
接着，样貌极美的女子，并未理会其他的山贼。
只见她白皙的手，快速的挥动，凝结出一个林浩看不懂的印记。
一股青色的风出现，卷着林浩和女子，腾空而起。
穿过一座座高山，地面的景象在飞速的倒退。
“人竟然可以飞！
难道这个世界可以修仙！”
林浩心中大为震惊。

呼呼的狂风，吹得他脸色苍白，身上单薄的粗布衣服，根本扛不住这寒冷，冻得直哆嗦。
content_en:
Chapter 1 Robbery of Immortal Cultivators
The sky is clear and clear, cloudless.
Zhao State, a desolate place on the edge of the Eastern Territory, a business road.
…
"I opened this mountain, I planted this tree...Girl, I'm here for you."
A boy of fifteen or sixteen years old, wearing a coarse cloth, carrying a broken knife, pretending to be ferocious on his immature face.
Behind him, there were more than ten men standing.
The clothes on these men were in tatters, like beggars.
Except for a few people who were holding iron weapons, most of them were holding wooden sticks and looked very embarrassed. However, their vicious appearance was still very intimidating to ordinary people.
They are bandits in this area and make a living by robbing passers-by on the trade routes.
The young man standing at the front is named Lin Hao.
He is the only person among this group of bandits who can read, and he has just become the leader of this group of bandits only a few months ago.
The woman stopped in front was about twenty years old and extremely beautiful.
She was wearing expensive clothes, which was in sharp contrast to this group of aloof bandits.
There are so many people blocking the way.
Her face was cold, and she didn't seem to be afraid. Her eyes fell on Lin Hao, the leader, and said, "I didn't expect to meet someone with cultivation qualifications in this remote place. Since meeting him is fate, come with me."
This sound, like the cold wind in the twelfth lunar month, contains some mysterious power.
Hearing this in the ears of the bandits, they felt inexplicably frightened.
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw the woman grabbing Lin Hao's hand in the air.
Suddenly a force entangled him, and his body flew forward uncontrollably with his horrified expression.
The woman's white hand waved again, and a blue light enveloped Lin Hao, making him unable to move.
"Da Dang...home!"
A group of bandits were terrified, their hands holding weapons were covered in cold sweat, but they did not dare to charge forward.
Obviously, this woman's ability was beyond their understanding.
"Little ones...save me..."
Lin Hao looked frightened and said with a mournful face: "Girl... have mercy on me, I... I only rob money, I have never hurt other people's lives, please let me go!"
He was originally an ordinary young man on earth. He accidentally fell off a cliff while traveling to a famous mountain. He came to this world inexplicably and became a unique time traveler.
It's not the kind of soul time travel, but the kind of real body time travel.
When he woke up, he found himself in a bandit's den. Relying on modern knowledge, he finally deceived the group of bandits and became the leader.
Unexpectedly, not long after he started his bandit career, he encountered an iron plate during robbery.
"Shut up."
The woman gave him a cold look, her eyes as terrifying as the King of Hell seeking his life.
Lin Hao was too frightened to say a word, trembling all over, standing nervously in the green light emanating from the woman.
Then, the extremely beautiful woman ignored the other bandits.
Her white hands were seen waving rapidly, forming a mark that Lin Hao couldn't understand.
A blue wind appeared and swept Lin Hao and the woman into the sky.
Passing through high mountains, the scene on the ground is rapidly retreating.
“People can actually fly!
Is it possible to cultivate immortality in this world? "
Lin Hao was shocked.
The howling wind made his face pale, and the thin coarse cloth clothes on his body could not withstand the cold at all, and he was shivering from the cold.
